**Indikator 1a** is a quality indicator used to measure the proportion of newly diagnosed adults with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) who undergo a [[koloskopi]] within 12 months before or after their first hospital contact [^src1]. It serves as a foundational metric for evaluating the quality of diagnostic workups at both the national and departmental levels in Denmark, as part of the broader efforts by the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] to standardize and improve IBD diagnostics [^src1].

Nationally, the development target for Indikator 1a has been met, with 79% of the 2,385 newly diagnosed adult patients receiving a colonoscopy within the specified timeframe [^src1]. However, performance varies across regions and specific hospital departments. For instance, in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], fulfillment rates range from 76% to 86% [^src1]. At the departmental level, four hospitals failed to meet the recommended threshold, with under 70% of their newly diagnosed adults being investigated in accordance with the guidelines: [[hvidovre|Hvidovre]], [[ouh-svendborg|OUH Svendborg]], [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]], and [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] [^src1].

The indicator specifically monitors colonoscopies performed with or without biopsies, as well as total colonoscopies [^src1]. While primarily focused on adults, the indicator's scope includes certain 17-year-old patients who begin their diagnostic workup in an adult department to ensure a continuous and coherent treatment course [^src1].

## Mentions
- Page 11: "For at sikre et sammenhængende behandlingsforløb starter enkelte unge på 17 år udredning på en voksenafdeling. Disse unge er inkluderet i indikator 1a og følger udredningsvejledningen for voksne." [^src1]

## Claims
**Performance**
- Udviklingsmålet for indikator 1a er nået på landsplan, da 79 % af de i alt 2385 nydiagnosticerede har fået foretaget koloskopi [^src1]
- Regional variation for indikator 1a ligger fra 76 % til 86 % i Region Sjælland [^src1]
- Fire afdelinger — Hvidovre, OUH Svendborg, Aarhus og Gødstrup — har under 70 % opfyldelse af indikator 1a [^src1]
